metaTitle: Custom Stylus Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom stylus lanyards & badges with built-in stylus tips. Perfect for tablets and touchscreens. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom stylus lanyards combine the convenience of a wearable badge holder with a built-in stylus tip, making them ideal for professionals who frequently use tablets, smartphones, or touchscreen kiosks. Unlike standard lanyards, the integrated stylus lets you navigate screens without smudging or removing gloves—perfect for trade shows, hospitals, or retail environments. Choose from woven, knit, or recycled materials and add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a functional giveaway that keeps your brand at users' fingertips.
heroAltText: Custom stylus lanyards badges with built-in stylus tips for touchscreen use, featuring woven material and full-color logo imprint.
